list_server_and_tools: list MCP tools from an SSE server URL and return initialize and tool responses
trim_schema: trim MCP JSON schema to Harmony-compatible format by removing title, default null, and anyOf
post_process_tools_description: post-process MCP tool descriptions to filter out tools not needed in prompts
add_tool_server: add MCP tool servers by URL and register their tools with Harmony descriptions
get_tool_session: get an async context manager session for a named tool from MCP or demo tool servers
